a.lede: The new standing committee will give board-level oversight of national security policies, export control compliance, and global trade risks, the company said.
a.title: Nvidia’s first big move after Jensen Huang’s exit targets national security

b.lede: This group will oversee the company's national security concerns and global trade compliance to avoid a repeat of Jensen's scandals.
b.title: Nvidia board establishes National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee in wake of Jensen Huang scandal
